tip: The command form of köra drops the final -a: köra becomes kör, drive.
Comparatives add -are to the adjective: glad becomes gladare, happier.
The perfect uses har plus a supine, and bli is irregular: har blivit.
sluta is followed by a plain infinitive, no att: slutat röka, quit smoking.
ta has the irregular supine tagit, used after har: har tagit.
After som a profession takes no article: jobbat som lärare, worked as a teacher.
Comparisons use än for than: yngre än mig, younger than me.
Definite superlative uses den plus -sta and keeps the noun definite: den längsta dagen.
gånger is the plural of gång and counts occurrences: tre gånger, three times.
borde means ought to and takes a plain infinitive: borde vi gå, we ought to go.
mycket before a comparative means much: mycket varmare, much warmer.
fylla plus år means to turn an age: jag fyller trettio år, I turn thirty.
bra is irregular: bra, bättre, bäst. The definite form here is det bästa.
For a span of time use i: i tjugo minuter, for twenty minutes.
sin means one's own and points back to the subject: sålt sin bil.
In a negative command, inte follows the verb: Ge inte upp, do not give up.
A container plus its contents needs no word for of: en flaska mineralvatten.
med plus a vehicle with no article means by: med tåg, by train.
njuta needs av before its object: njut av resan, enjoy the trip.
To ask a question is ställa en fråga, not fråga: hon ställde en fråga.
With an ett-word the adjective adds -t: ren becomes rent, ett rent kök.
vill ha is the fixed phrase for want: jag vill ha lite grädde.
Make a decision is fatta ett beslut, not göra: vi måste fatta beslut.
The prefix jätte- means really or super: jättemycket, very much.
akta sig för means watch out for, using a reflexive: akta dig för is.
för att introduces a reason, meaning because: för att solen skiner.
After det a definite adjective ends in -a: det öppna fönstret, the open window.
sedan marks a starting point in time, meaning since: sedan han var sex.
varje is followed by a singular noun: varje morgon, every morning.
liten is irregular; with an ett-word it becomes litet: ett litet barn.
för att plus an infinitive means in order to: för att hålla dig frisk.
på grund av means because of and takes a noun: på grund av värmen.
det finns means there is or there are: det finns barn.
tappa bort means to lose or misplace, and alltid splits it: tappar alltid bort.
